correctness.rationale: Exact cover U_i=N[G_i]*Delta_(other vertices) has intersection over S equal to (join of K_i in S)*simplex on remaining factor vertices. Every proper nonempty intersection is contractible and the full intersection is K=* K_i. For k=2, union is the homotopy pushout of two contractibles over K, hence ΣK. Induction on k (first k-1 cover contractible; its intersection with U_k another k-1 cover) proves Σ^(k-1)K without suspension cancellation. For integral equivariance the full-intersection summand in the reduced Mayer–Vietoris/Čech complex shifts by k-1 and acquires factor-index orientation sgn(π), in addition to the graded join permutation. For m≥5 each N[C_m] loses its triangle/diagonal free pairs onto C_m, with dihedral orientation character; k-fold circle join is S^(2k-1), so final sphere S^(3k-2), and a factor swap acts by the additional Čech -1. Complement of C_m is connected for m≥5, so Aut(C_m^∨k)=D_m wr S_k. Independent finite face/boundary checks produced reduced mod-2 β4=1 for C5∨C5 (902 nonempty faces) and C5∨C6 (1618 faces). Finite checks do not prove the universal theorem, which rests on the cover/cofibration argument.

originality.rationale: The full unsuspended multi-factor join homotopy law is not provided by the inspected prior works. Matsushita Theorem 1.2 gives ΣN[complement H] ≃ I(K2×H); for H=disjoint union of complements, its join decomposition implies the suspended shadow ΣN[J] ≃ Σ^k(K1*...*Kk), but suspension cancellation is invalid in general. Its stable consequences, and the induced homology character when derivable naturally from the stable comparison, are not separately novel. The published Lovász universal-vertex join theorem uses OPEN neighborhoods and only K_r∨H, while C4-free closed-neighborhood collapses determine the individual cycle factor but not the general graph-join law. The direct unsuspended cover result and broad arbitrary-factor scope survive best-of-knowledge comparison.
